subject: BluePeak Marketplace connector: entitlement, security evidence, and billing mapping
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@bluepeak.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T10:12:00Z
Subject: BluePeak marketplace connector: next steps and tech asks

Hi Lena / Samir —

Great to meet earlier. Quick follow-up with the minimal ops / engineering asks so we can keep the listing timeline tight:

1) Entitlement & SKU mapping: we need a mapping table that maps BluePeak SKUs to marketplace SKUs (AWS/GCP). Please confirm which of your plans are metered vs subscription.
2) Billing integration: will BluePeak push usage events to us (webhook) or will we pull? If push, please provide the webhook schema or sample events.
3) Security evidence: SOC2 artifacts + an IP allowlist for API access (if required). Olga can intake zipped evidence.
4) Private Offers: customer-facing private-offer terms — if you expect private offers, we need the preferred template and a single point of contact for PO negotiations.

I attached a short connector spec (connector-spec-v2.md) with recommended endpoints and an initial set of entitlements. Ben will follow up on go-to-market copy for the listing.

Goal: get a minimally viable listing ready for private-offer pilots by end of July. Can you confirm owners and timelines?

Thanks,
Priyom
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: connector-spec-v2.md
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@bluepeak.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@bluepeak.ai>
Date: 2028-07-04T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: BluePeak marketplace connector: next steps and tech asks

Priyom — thanks for the clear list. Short answers and owners:

- SKU mapping: Samir (engineering) will produce a first-pass mapping (CSV) by EOD 07-06. We have three plans (Core, Pro, Enterprise). Core/Pro are metered; Enterprise is subscription.
- Billing integration: we plan to push usage events to Redwood via webhook. I attached our sample event payload (we'll add more if you need).
- Security evidence: sending SOC2 bundle to Olga — will share a password-protected zip by 07-05.
- Private Offers: procurement@bluepeak.ai will be the contact; we can use your privatelist-template.docx as a starting point.

Owners: Samir (samir@bluepeak.ai) - technical; Lena (lena@bluepeak.ai) - commercial.

Next: Samir to sync with Ben on metered-event fields (meter_id, quantity, timestamp) and retry/backoff semantics.

—Lena
VP Partnerships, BluePeak Analytics

Attachments: (referenced) SOC2-evidence.zip (will be delivered via SFTP), sample-usage-event.json
From: Samir Gupta <samir@bluepeak.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-05T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: BluePeak marketplace connector: next steps and tech asks

Ben / Priyom — looping in engineering. A few technical clarifications from our side after reviewing connector-spec-v2.md: 

- Metering fields: we'll send meter_id, usage_value, granularity, resource_id, and iso8601 timestamp. Do you require any additional customer identifiers (e.g., marketplace-customer-id) in the payload?
- Auth: we propose mutual TLS for the webhook endpoint plus an HMAC header to protect against replay. Is mutual TLS compatible with Redwood's collector endpoint?
- KV cache: we plan to include a hashed token per request — if you have a recommended TTL for cache keys to optimize for batching, please advise.

Also, for marketplace listing copy: Ben, can you confirm the short product blurb (1-2 lines) and three bullets we can show on AWS/GCP? We want to align messaging with the technical entitlements.

Thanks,
Samir
Lead Engineer, BluePeak
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@bluepeak.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-06T13:40:00Z
Subject: Re: BluePeak marketplace connector: next steps and tech asks

Samir — quick replies inline: 

- marketplace-customer-id: yes, include it when available. We'll accept marketplace_customer_id OR email-hash for reconciliation.
- mutual TLS: fine from our side; we will provision a collector endpoint that supports mTLS + HMAC. Olga, please create the onboarding ticket for cert exchange and secure endpoint URL.
- TTL for KV cache: 90s default is reasonable for metered usage aggregation; we can tweak per workload.

Draft listing blurb (feel free to edit):
"BluePeak Analytics: real-time insights for LLM-powered applications — low-latency embeddings and retriever pipelines with per-tenant privacy controls."
Three bullets:
- High-throughput inference with predictable pricing and usage-based billing.
- Enterprise data residency and private-offer support.
- Simple webhook-based usage reporting and automated entitlement mapping.

Lena/Samir — if that copy looks good we'll push to the AWS/GCP listing templates and request screenshots.

Ben
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@bluepeak.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir@bluepeak.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-08T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: BluePeak marketplace connector: next steps and tech asks

Thanks all — operational checklist and immediate asks: 

1) Samir: please upload the CSV SKU mapping to the HubSpot deal folder and include the marketplace_customer_id column. Link: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/8429
2) Samir: send mutual TLS cert (cert.pem) and client cert chain to our SFTP (instructions attached). I'll open ticket #INT-4597 for cert exchange.
3) Lena: SOC2 zip received (incoming via SFTP). I'll validate and confirm scope by 07-10.
4) BluePeak: please confirm whether the Enterprise subscription has a free-trial period (we need this for listing terms).
5) Ben/Priyom: once listing copy is approved, I will request AWS/GCP catalog previews and add entitlement metadata (entitlement IDs) to the listing.

Attachments referenced: privatelist-template.docx (commercial), onboarding-sftp-instructions.txt

Olga
Technical Integrations Program Manager
Redwood Inference
